question: PR Sreejesh is a ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hockey player**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PR Sreejesh is a **hockey player**.
 
• He is a well-known figure in Indian field hockey and has served as the goalkeeper for the Indian national team.
 
• Sreejesh has been instrumental in many of India's victories in international hockey tournaments.
 
• He has received several accolades for his outstanding contributions to the sport, including the prestigious Arjuna Award and the Padma Shri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• PR Sreejesh was born on May 8, 1988, in Ernakulam, Kerala.
 
• He started his career in hockey at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks due to his exceptional skills as a goalkeeper.
 
• He has played a vital role in India's performances in the Olympics, Asian Games, and various other international tournaments.
 
• In addition to his sports career, Sreejesh is also known for his leadership qualities and has captained the Indian hockey team on multiple occasions.
 
• His dedication and passion for the game continue to inspire young athletes across the country.
